notes: Business actions for /sc4sap:assist, executed only through ZMCP_BIZ_EXECUTE on the SAP side.
Handler checked on ECC740-DEV (ECC 6.0, 740) on 2026-11-09 with the verification harness (actions-evidence/ECC740-DEV.txt); S4-DEV and ECC731-DEV pending.

Order actions use BAPI_SALESORDER_CHANGE with SIMULATION (rollback) and BAPI_SALESORDER_CREATEFROMDAT2 with TESTRUN; save-time customer rules are previewed from the customer check rules of the system (biz-rules/SD.json).

Delivery creation and the goods-issue reversal have no usable test mode: previews are static (status, configuration, rules). The goods issue preview runs WS_DELIVERY_UPDATE_2 in check mode (IF_DATABASE_UPDATE = 2), proven not to save. Billing create and cancel use TESTRUN.
The handler runs its own authorization check for delivery, goods issue and billing and refuses when it fails (fail closed).
Amounts: the BAPI interface carries currency amounts in the internal (2-decimal) scale; the handler converts them, so inputs and outputs are real amounts.

Not offered: credit release (SD_ORDER_CREDIT_RELEASE is an internal FM without authorization check or return table), delivery deletion, order deletion, credit and debit memo requests (value-based items are not supported by SD.SO.CREATE).
Customer master, partner and address data are never returned: list and detail actions read documents only.
